category.sound_physics_perfected.own_voi: The volume of your own voice
yacl3.config.${id}:config.raysCast.descr: # of Rays to cast from players\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
yacl3.config.${id}:config.raysBounced.de: Max # of times the ray will bounce before terminating\n(More accurate for hearing sounds after bouncing off walls, INCREASING THIS WILL INCREASE REVERB)\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
yacl3.config.${id}:config.maxRayLength.d: Max Length of a singular ray \nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
yacl3.config.${id}:config.procRange.desc: Max distance that SPP will proccess your sound. \n(-1 is infinite range)
yacl3.config.${id}:config.tickRate.descr:
How often sounds' positions should be updated
(0 is off)
(1 = every tick -> 20 = every second)
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
yacl3.config.${id}:config.soundMult.desc: 1 is just default Minecraft sound dist\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
yacl3.config.${id}:config.volumeMultipli: exactly what it sounds like, you can make sounds louder if u want ig.
yacl3.config.${id}:config.reverb.descrip: Cast Blue (Reverb Detecting) Rays and add reverb dynamically to sources\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
yacl3.config.${id}:config.permeation.des: Cast Red (Permeating) Rays and add muffle dynamically to permeated sources\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
yacl3.config.${id}:config.permeationStep: Only used when Fast Raytracing is off (or near Sable sub-levels): lower = more precise, but slower\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
yacl3.config.${id}:config.permeatedTickR:
How often permeated sounds' positions should be updated
(0 is off)
(1 = every tick -> 20 = every second)
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM (higher than normal tickrate)
yacl3.config.${id}:config.attenuationTyp: This setting is now largely irrelevant, if you liked the way the mod sounded in the past, this helps. otherwise ignore\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: NONE
yacl3.config.${id}:config.rayBounce.desc: Larger = less heavily the sound will be coming from walls (will make likely make sounds quieter)\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: NONE
yacl3.config.${id}:config.debug.descript:
puts sound names in chat.   

CAN CAUSE CRASHES WITH SODIUM 
(idk why, its really weird) 
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: SMALL
yacl3.config.${id}:config.maxBlocksPerme: Max blocks permeated in the calculation
yacl3.config.${id}:config.permeationAbso: Volume is multiplied by x^blocksTraveled where x is the value set here for muffle
yacl3.config.${id}:config.barrierAsAir.d: Make it so barriers do NOT absorb sound
yacl3.config.${id}:config.shortcutDirect: if direct LOS, use that directionality instead of ray traced \n this removes weird audio panning when having directionality
yacl3.config.${id}:config.maxSounds.desc: Maximum # of sounds the mod is allowed to process
yacl3.config.${id}:config.fastRaytracing: Traces rays directly through the block grid instead of using Minecraft's generic ray casting. Same results, several times faster.\nTurns itself off near Sable sub-levels; turn it off if another mod adds geometry that sound should bounce off.\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: FASTER
yacl3.config.${id}:config.lowLatencyBudg: How long the game may wait each tick for new sounds to finish tracing, so they play on the same tick instead of one tick (50 ms) late.\n0 = never wait\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: SMALL (only while new sounds play)
Distant sounds lose their high frequencies, like in real air.\n1 = physically accurate, 0 = off
yacl3.config.${id}:config.bounceAbsorpti: how much should be absorbed (1.0 is no absorption, 0.5 is volume reduced by 1/2)
Disables FX on Master Category, off by default bc some mods will get ignored if this is on
yacl3.config.${id}:config.reverbTuning.d: Shows the reverb the mod computed for your surroundings (decay time, levels, room size).
yacl3.config.${id}:config.useExplosionRe: Use Explosion Resistance for how much each block muffles sound\nExplosionFactor / 6, deepslate being the default. Dense blocks that explode easily (dirt, sand, gravel, glass, snow) still muffle at least what their material should.
yacl3.config.${id}:config.legacyReverb.d: Switches reverb mode to different versions TUNING IS NOT ALWAYS AVAILABLE
yacl3.config.${id}:config.experimentalRe: Enables an experimental reverb which allows reverb to be louder than
yacl3.config.${id}:config.directionalRev: Echoes come from where they really bounce: reflections lean towards a nearby wall, and at a cave mouth the cave's reverb comes from inside the cave.
yacl3.config.${id}:config.reverbZones.de: Sounds in a different space from you ring like that space: a zombie deep in a cave echoes like the cave while you stand outside, heard from the cave's direction and only as loud as that echo reaches you.
How many times rays keep bouncing to measure the room (they stop connecting to sounds after Ray Bounced #). More = steadier reverb in complex caves and buildings.\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: LOW
yacl3.config.${id}:config.globalReverbIn: Overall reverb level\nHigher = more intense reverb (2 is the default mix)
yacl3.config.${id}:config.reverbSmoothin: How quickly the reverb follows you into a new space.\nLower = snappier, higher = smoother
yacl3.config.${id}:config.decayTimeMulti: Scales how long reverb tails last. 1 = physically based on the room's size and materials
yacl3.config.${id}:config.maxDecayTime.d: Soft limit on reverb tail length, so huge caves stay pleasant.\nShort tails are not affected
yacl3.config.${id}:config.reflectionsMul: Level of the first echoes off nearby walls
yacl3.config.${id}:config.echoMultiplier: Strength of distinct echoes off far away cliffs and walls when you are outside
yacl3.config.${id}:config.maxOverallGain: Maximum overall reverb gain\nPrevents reverb from being too loud
yacl3.config.${id}:config.baseHfReferenc: Base high frequency reference (Hz)\nHigher = affects higher frequencies
yacl3.config.${id}:config.baseLfReferenc: Base low frequency reference (Hz)\nHigher = affects higher low frequencies
yacl3.config.${id}:config.soundBlacklist: Does not have to be a full match, will blacklist anything that CONTAINS that name
yacl3.config.${id}:config.soundTickBlack: Does not have to be a full match, will blacklist anything that CONTAINS that name
yacl3.config.${id}:config.voicechatRever: Make it so you can hear your own reverb bc Skizzy promised me clout.
yacl3.config.${id}:config.voicechatMuffl: Makes Volume Lower through walls for Jukeboxes/Players
